description: Each loss requires a period. When they arrive faster than the period, none of them are completed, and the person carries a stack of unfinished grief that presents clinically as depression rather than mourning.
Faced with four losses the mind picks one to feel and suppresses the rest. The suppressed ones surface years later, often at an unrelated funeral, with full original intensity.
energy_note: A grief that ambushes you at a stranger's service.

description: When most of a family is gone, one person holds every name, recipe, story and grudge. It is a duty nobody assigned and it cannot be put down.
energy_note: Being the last person who remembers any of it.

description: Eleven members. Four are dead. He cannot leave the group and cannot open it.
energy_note: An app you check and cannot read.
